name: callverify-merge-relay
description: Two-phase merge-detection relay for the CallVerify Twilio port. Hosts the inbound-only WebSocket endpoint that Twilio Media Streams connects to. Phase 1 matches the spoken-prompt fingerprint plus a light 852+1336 Hz (DTMF-8) watermark; Phase 2 runs the existing loud DTMF-8 Goertzel detector alone. Each phase independently finalizes MERGE_DETECTED and posts a structured verdict callback to the main app.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check lib/relay.js && node --check lib/detectors.js && node --check lib/dsp.js && node --check lib/state.js && node --check tools/generate-fingerprint.mjs && node --check selftest.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test test/ && node selftest.mjs
